stem:
Meera drops four objects one by one on the kitchen floor and listens to the sound each makes.

Three of them produce a ringing sound, showing that they are sonorous. Which object does not produce a ringing sound?

teacher.key_rationale: Steel, copper and brass are metals and produce a ringing sound when struck or dropped, so they are sonorous. Charcoal is a non-metal and gives a dull sound, so it is not sonorous; B is the key.
